title: Snorkl
description: A closer look at your app’s network. Inspect HTTP and WebSocket traffic from Android or a browser on your local network.
problem: Inspecting HTTP requests and WebSocket messages while developing an Android app.
approach: An OkHttp interceptor and WebSocket listener collect network activity. A native Android activity and a local web dashboard expose request and response details.
imageAlt: Actual Snorkl network inspection web dashboard

title: GraphQL Formatter
description: From a query in a Kotlin string to something you can actually read. A GraphQL formatting plugin for IntelliJ.
problem: GraphQL queries stored inside Kotlin variables can be difficult to read and edit.
approach: Import a query from a named variable into an IntelliJ tool window, format and edit it, then replace the variable’s value.
imageAlt: Actual GraphQL Formatter IntelliJ tool window

title: Circular Reveal Widget
description: A little motion, a different perspective. A Flutter widget that adds a circular reveal to your interface.
problem: Reveal a Flutter interface through an animated circular clipping region.
approach: Use a custom clipper, animation progress, and gesture positions to control a circular reveal. The accompanying article walks through the implementation.

title: Bluetooth LE Chat
description: Exploring nearby connections. An Android chat application built around Bluetooth Low Energy and GATT.
problem: Understand how Android devices exchange messages using Bluetooth Low Energy.
approach: A three-part published series introduces BLE, sets up a GATT server, and connects a GATT client.
